prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1417; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep my name off this if that's okay. You can call me the driver.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in Houston, Texas, heading down a main road toward a shopping center. I was turning left into the parking lot.

Q: What was the weather and traffic like at the time?

A: It was clear and dry. Traffic was moderate, nothing unusual. I was waiting for a gap in the oncoming lanes.

Q: Did you have a green light or a turn arrow?

A: I had a green light, but no arrow. I waited for the oncoming car to clear the intersection before I started my turn.

Q: What happened next?

A: As I got partway through the turn, another vehicle came through from the opposite direction and hit the front passenger side of my car. I didn't see it coming in time to avoid it.

Q: Did you feel any injury immediately after the impact?

A: My neck felt fine at first, but within a few hours my lower back was stiff and sore. By the next morning it was hard to bend over or sit for long.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then. The doctor diagnosed a lumbar strain.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been missing some work because of the pain, and I'm still dealing with it. That's about all I can say right now.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
